prompt: How many letters long is the title of the first movie composed by the composer of the first American Godzilla movie?
answer:
The first American-made *Godzilla* movie was **Godzilla (1998)**, composed by **David Arnold**. His first film score was *The Young Americans*.

**“The Young Americans” has 17 letters** (excluding spaces).
